description: [read-only] Retrieve objects inside an ABAP package as a flat list. Supports recursive traversal of subpackages.

include_descriptions.description: Include object descriptions in response (default: true)

include_subpackages.description: Include contents of subpackages recursively (default: false)

max_depth.description: Maximum depth for recursive package traversal (default: 5)

name: GetPackageContents
